text: Start at Stats Visualitzation section (left menu), when active, Filters Menu appears in the sidebar
Input the coordinates or perform a search by ID
Choose which populaitons or metapopulations you would like to see
Specify the p-value cutoff for iHS and nSL, and wether you prefer to see all data or only the extreme values
Specify the p-value cutoff for iSAFE, and wether you prefer to see all data or only the extreme values
Modify the information you want to see displayed in the Functional Description tab
Choose the clock model, years per generation and any other filters you want to apply in the Age Informaiton tab
All changes need to be confirmed by clicking the update button under the Filters Menu
For more detailed information, check the Tutorial tab
